name: Thermal Analysis Studio
description: Radiometric image analysis for DJI, Teledyne FLIR, Skydio and Autel thermal cameras: temperature statistics and isotherms, range isolation, AI variance analysis, heat-flow networks, Metashape orthomosaics and thermal inspection reports. Includes the DJI Thermal SDK runtime; FLIR-format R-JPEGs, Autel radiometric TIFFs and temperature CSVs are read natively.
